provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Private Prison

examples.psychological_goal: 一句假设把观众的拥有幻想变成共同语境
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称幻想式开场（so you want to own a X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to own a private prison.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"所以你想拥有一家X"直接开局，先给幻想再给反转
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体资产对象

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连身份重定义完成开场反转，制造认知错位
examples.expression_mechanism: 排比重定义（客户是X，占用者是Y，产品是Z）
examples.example_text: The customer is the government. The prisoner is the occupant and the product is a human being locked in a cell.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用三个排比短句把熟悉概念陌生化
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该行业身份组合

examples.psychological_goal: 用议程预告把悬念转化为可等待的结构
examples.expression_mechanism: 内部视角承诺（costs, contracts, risks 三词清单）
examples.example_text: An inside look at the costs, contracts, risks, and what the real economic reality of this industry is.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用名词清单式预告为长片立路标
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该清单的具体条目

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个长时段百分比锚定市场起源
examples.expression_mechanism: 长时段变化百分比（increased by X% between A and B）
examples.example_text: In the United States, the prison population increased by approximately 500% between 1972 and 2008.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"起止年份+百分比"为趋势给坐标
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体百分比与年份

examples.psychological_goal: 正式交付商业模式的核心重定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定-肯定三连（不是A，是B，C才是客户）
examples.example_text: The prisoner is not a customer. The prisoner is a product. The government is the customer.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用短句三连把"谁付钱"与"谁被交易"拆开
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该重定义的具体对象

examples.psychological_goal: 用运营商财报的单位成本区间锚定成本讨论
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位成本区间（per X per Y range from A to B）
examples.example_text: operating expenses per prisoner per day range from about $72 to $76.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"每单位每周期"口径把总成本切成可比较的数

examples.psychological_goal: 用承上启下句为下一段反转开门
examples.expression_mechanism: 收束换挡（Which brings us to the central X paradox）
examples.example_text: Which brings us to the central labor paradox of this industry.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"这把我们带到X悖论"完成段落接力
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该悖论的具体内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用"表格与实践"对照完成劳动悖论的冷面判词
examples.expression_mechanism: 场景对仗+同词回环（on a spreadsheet vs in practice；cheapest...not the cheapest）
examples.example_text: On a spreadsheet, the math looks extraordinary. In practice, this is a trap because the cheapest employee is not necessarily the cheapest to hire.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个场景的对照句揭示"账面与现实的鸿沟"

examples.psychological_goal: 用三重更高发生率把人群风险基数钉实
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连名词短语+比较级（higher rates of A, B, and C than D）
examples.example_text: significantly higher rates of mental illness, infectious diseases, and chronic health conditions than similar age groups within the free population.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用并列三类风险+对照组为后续机制铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 用"每一笔支出直接扣减净收入"命名恶性激励
examples.expression_mechanism: 逐笔扣减句式（every dollar spent on X directly subtracts from Y）
examples.example_text: Every dollar spent on an outside specialist, necessary surgery, or emergency transportation directly subtracts from the facility’s net operating income.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"每花一X就少一Y"展示激励方向而非道德评判
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该具体支出项

examples.psychological_goal: 用跨资产对照让搁浅资产的绝望落地
examples.expression_mechanism: 属性堆叠+用途否定（empty X is essentially useless for any other purpose）
examples.example_text: An empty maximum security prison is essentially useless for any other commercial purpose.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"对其他一切用途都无用"强调专用资产风险

examples.psychological_goal: 冷峻判词：商业结构要求稳定的人口供应
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟物化需求句式（demands a constant and reliable supply of X）
examples.example_text: demands a constant and reliable supply of humans to fill the beds.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用供应链语言描述不该被供应的东西，制造不适

examples.psychological_goal: 把叙事从案例拉升到全片中央教训
examples.expression_mechanism: 元叙述拉升句（This brings us to the central lesson of X）
examples.example_text: This brings us to the central business lesson of the entire industry.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"这把我们带到中央教训"为论点层开场
examples.negative_instruction: 拉升后必须给出真正的教训句

examples.psychological_goal: 用检查细节的四连意象把运营恶化具象化
examples.example_text: found blood on the walls, vomit in the corridors, cockroaches in the health unit and a heavy odor of drugs in every wing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用检查报告式的短名词串让恶化可见
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该细节组合；细节须服务于机制论证

examples.psychological_goal: 用奖金条件句演示激励对齐的合同设计
examples.expression_mechanism: 条件式奖金机制（earned bonus if X at a rate lower than Y）
examples.example_text: earned bonus payments if prisoners released from the facility committed crimes at a rate lower than the state average.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"结果好于基准才付费"重设激励方向
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该指标与基准

examples.psychological_goal: 把公私之争重构为系统激励之争
examples.expression_mechanism: 辩题重构（the real debate is about what X creates）
examples.example_text: The real debate is about what incentives the entire system built around imprisonment creates.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"真正的辩论是关于……"替换观众的二元对立

examples.psychological_goal: 系统级判词：不是异常，只是发布季报的那部分
examples.expression_mechanism: 去特殊化+显性化对照（not an anomaly; only the part that publishes X）
examples.example_text: Private prisons are not an anomaly in the economics of imprisonment. This is only the part of the system that publishes quarterly earnings reports.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"它只是系统中唯一透明的那部分"颠覆批判焦点

examples.psychological_goal: 以创作者致谢与感谢观看完成低姿态收束
examples.expression_mechanism: 投入自陈+支持放大句（means more than you think）
examples.example_text: I put a lot of work into these and your support probably means more than you think. Thanks for watching.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在重内容片尾用克制的个人化致谢收尾

warnings: no_humor_type_examples: source narration contains no genuine humor mechanism (only isolated deadpan irony), so the humor type is intentionally not covered; all six required types are covered
